description: This Java test class sets up a benchmarking scenario for mapping JavaScript code to Ditto protocol messages. It defines a Java class implementing a specific interface to provide a message mapper configured with a JavaScript script that constructs a JSON payload, and manages ExternalMessage creation.

classes.name: Test4ConstructJsonPayloadToDitto
classes.description: A JMH benchmark class that sets up a JavaScript-based message mapper for testing JSON payload construction in Ditto protocol.
